issues.description: Constructor parameter ordering for Course is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement and the template show/expect an initializer signature that accepts parameters in the order (name:, instructor:, ratings:). In the solution repository the Course initializer is declared with parameters in the order (instructor:, name:, ratings:), while the solution's Client calls Course(name:..., instructor:..., ratings:...). This mismatch (declaration vs. call) and the difference from the problem/template ordering is a structural inconsistency that will confuse students reading the solution and may lead to compilation or usage errors if order/labels are relied upon.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Course initializer parameter labels and order consistent across all artifacts. Prefer the (name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) signature used in the problem statement and template. Update the solution's Course initializer to init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) (and keep the Client call as-is), or alternatively update the Client and problem/template examples to match the solution's declaration. Ensure all three artifacts use the same parameter labels and order.

issues.description: The problem statement and the template show the Course initializer as Course(name:instructor:ratings:), but the solution defines the initializer with the parameter labels in a different order (init(instructor: name: ratings:)). This misalignment between the expected constructor signature and the solution (and the client call that uses name: first) creates confusion when students map the example usage in the problem to the implementation and can lead to compile/call-site mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Course initializer signature across artifacts. Change the solution's initializer to init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) so it matches the problem example and the template (or alternatively, update the example and template to use init(instructor:name:ratings:) consistently). Ensure the Client construction uses the same parameter label order as the initializer.
